bio.text: Bennie Foster is an independent candidate for Mississippi's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.

He is a native of Jackson, Mississippi, earned a bachelor's degree from Jackson State University and a master's in education from Strayer University, and has worked in public-service jobs in education.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 2nd U.S. Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
